Glutathione may help lower acetaldehyde levels during alcohol metabolism, but ` [Highlight start] human evidence showing it actually relieves hangover symptoms is limited and mixed [Highlight end] `.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXVByHTIAJo5M4AWPAPlxFmhDvhoe3WnVeMfuAGAoDGvfLHL-YoAfGT0zrmNr3hFkW7KA5rvich8rnrKe1I93ViKMdmARcySHDmAmWJV3rfKg98q66Eck5mM38Ypyd1h68Bkp48MQKS2c)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXXidHGrC8QN62dgGIOTJil9FrdImJvBGE3txJyfnridtMFSauhN8ZKSixIedCIrvtReYlHPqNR-Q4oRa9GxojofGAK1pPiRY1VgaUD-2VY6VjZ_0zKf3TteeyYewWZ_Q9LFd3jpc)

### How It Relates to Hangovers

- **Acetaldehyde & oxidative stress:** Breaking down alcohol creates toxic acetaldehyde and reactive oxygen species, while depleting the body's natural glutathione stores.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXOKqk4x9CTdG_SjJ0OfPJsNM_P2YBP78OSSsnO6QdeZROqr9uDc5yxOK0aLeOnIIsqRgduIv8Pq0mP6jSjta50bTXbT-vQxYe6XUQMs4glQM3nRB-_WThuBGRhHU39e5K_9dnJJpfwqQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXVByHTIAJo5M4AWPAPlxFmhDvhoe3WnVeMfuAGAoDGvfLHL-YoAfGT0zrmNr3hFkW7KA5rvich8rnrKe1I93ViKMdmARcySHDmAmWJV3rfKg98q66Eck5mM38Ypyd1h68Bkp48MQKS2c)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESxAEBxCJF1_b20StVOIIpLvAb0adF-7ZPMvNo09iDtKW2PPgwKrLomaMu63vDome49uYFv4zNFLTa7ltlmWWtHJjP42M_HiBtqDfXFhxijbqe5ZCm4B8dNNOTRVG1mTym1C72k1VsRcLf7qm02xnQKE3Dm7fGpdG8IAJSvD3jg-ciJTsZj4JpFPreKDIVkmXEy0CYS8jWvDu7gH1pw8Nl1x6n3HEmUYRpDWUToQn1476nGcUVbLWxfgjQR-cnFw7OWMNwloL8)
- **Enzyme & antioxidant support:** Animal and lab studies suggest glutathione supports antioxidant defenses and alcohol-metabolizing enzymes, though translating this into consistent symptom relief in people remains uncertain.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXFolbANiXultiOlyGK_IM7ZthklTD3qT8IazJn-yN_uagE5MhttBUDi79md4jKkQsfpb3X5b8WPybzzVwddHPzmPPtWl_pNTAKhvNGRJplSxUDyyVAfvcN13kejpxoxxnjdaNXtjBwKc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF16IQttVDOnaMdrLx4aeuz1mQgk_-LBZbPhGxK2qtInEVSuuOhDEdsJpTZmQ6w76i-ccPskvKq9Z7wuyPEZholz-nGkLhB72silm78ZfV2uq3XTeOPd9NywxQdhf1FEDCIkl_pq4hdqs56j0ANm4aAfqrtd7B74WK9eoTYpsoioU9)

#### What Human Studies Show

- **Lower acetaldehyde, mixed symptom scores:** In a randomized crossover trial using yeast extract containing glutathione before drinking, participants had lower blood acetaldehyde levels than with placebo, yet hangover symptom scores and blood alcohol levels did not meaningfully differ.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXXidHGrC8QN62dgGIOTJil9FrdImJvBGE3txJyfnridtMFSauhN8ZKSixIedCIrvtReYlHPqNR-Q4oRa9GxojofGAK1pPiRY1VgaUD-2VY6VjZ_0zKf3TteeyYewWZ_Q9LFd3jpc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXVByHTIAJo5M4AWPAPlxFmhDvhoe3WnVeMfuAGAoDGvfLHL-YoAfGT0zrmNr3hFkW7KA5rvich8rnrKe1I93ViKMdmARcySHDmAmWJV3rfKg98q66Eck5mM38Ypyd1h68Bkp48MQKS2c)
- **Practical limitations:** Oral glutathione can be broken down during digestion, and many hangover claims rely on small trials or animal research rather than large, independent human studies. For more details on the human trial data, see this [clinical trial on glutathione and hangover improvement](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXVByHTIAJo5M4AWPAPlxFmhDvhoe3WnVeMfuAGAoDGvfLHL-YoAfGT0zrmNr3hFkW7KA5rvich8rnrKe1I93ViKMdmARcySHDmAmWJV3rfKg98q66Eck5mM38Ypyd1h68Bkp48MQKS2c).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXFolbANiXultiOlyGK_IM7ZthklTD3qT8IazJn-yN_uagE5MhttBUDi79md4jKkQsfpb3X5b8WPybzzVwddHPzmPPtWl_pNTAKhvNGRJplSxUDyyVAfvcN13kejpxoxxnjdaNXtjBwKc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF16IQttVDOnaMdrLx4aeuz1mQgk_-LBZbPhGxK2qtInEVSuuOhDEdsJpTZmQ6w76i-ccPskvKq9Z7wuyPEZholz-nGkLhB72silm78ZfV2uq3XTeOPd9NywxQdhf1FEDCIkl_pq4hdqs56j0ANm4aAfqrtd7B74WK9eoTYpsoioU9)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEBxCJF1x04PjtLb2G8uScDyPX7AZSthzuoa3jWDaf_kmHHEBATW8cCRhxxVPAd-U5nGlBbOBY_w0_d7-Ad_N7Q8eNO6b5mr6pHct-SNdG7I2SpgbmvbqJsoZo5gE6r0qWc7socq10eOwpkuZJfAA50qqZtRwMvIGt5O7YuEAhKaG-kN9xM1prJHwI50JtJsIDGaa6XbPqZc6AmKNTCY_7mSp8CN1Y)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXVByHTIAJo5M4AWPAPlxFmhDvhoe3WnVeMfuAGAoDGvfLHL-YoAfGT0zrmNr3hFkW7KA5rvich8rnrKe1I93ViKMdmARcySHDmAmWJV3rfKg98q66Eck5mM38Ypyd1h68Bkp48MQKS2c)

#### Practical Context

- Glutathione does not prevent intoxication or speed up alcohol elimination reliably.
- Hydration, rest, food, and pacing alcohol intake remain the most dependable ways to prevent or ease hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXVByHTIAJo5M4AWPAPlxFmhDvhoe3WnVeMfuAGAoDGvfLHL-YoAfGT0zrmNr3hFkW7KA5rvich8rnrKe1I93ViKMdmARcySHDmAmWJV3rfKg98q66Eck5mM38Ypyd1h68Bkp48MQKS2c)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXXidHGrC8QN62dgGIOTJil9FrdImJvBGE3txJyfnridtMFSauhN8ZKSixIedCIrvtReYlHPqNR-Q4oRa9GxojofGAK1pPiRY1VgaUD-2VY6VjZ_0zKf3TteeyYewWZ_Q9LFd3jpc)
